node.title: Re^5: File permissions problem (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [wdhammond|Wayne],

So what's the result of running those commands to check on your umask setting? Update: Oh, I misunderstood [id://1177888|your post] because of the formatting! (missing <code> tags; I just considered the node for editing)

Taking a look a the function SaveUTF from [https://sourceforge.net/p/guiguts/git/ci/master/tree/lib/Guiguts/TextUnicode.pm#l59|the source] that you also posted in your other reply, it appears the module is saving files by using [doc://File::Temp] to create a new file, and then replacing the old file with an [doc://unlink] and a [doc://rename]. [doc://File::Temp] apparently sets the files it creates to mode 0600. I don't see an option to change that, so it'd probably be necessary to [doc://chmod] the files after creation. You could simply set it to an explicit mode like 0640, or you could use the current [doc://umask] like so: chmod(0666&~umask,$filename);

Regards,
-- Hauke D
